book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.a:
The **Accelerator Plate** will speed up any entity moving on it, up to a limit. \
  \
Whatever direction it's already moving, it'll move that direction faster.

The **Advanced Item Collector** is an upgraded version of the [Item Collector](entry://blocks/item_collector). Its collection volume is configurable, ranging from 0 to 10 blocks in each direction. \
  \
Each axis (X/Y/Z) can be configured independently, as well.
Additionally, you can insert an [Item Filter](entry://items/item_filter), and it will only collect items that match the filter.

The **Advanced Redstone Interface** will transmit its own received redstone signal strength to up to 9 linked blocks. \
  \
Insert [Location Filters](entry://items/location_filter) to link it to those blocks.
The **Advanced Redstone Torch** has a configurable redstone signal strength for when its powered and unpowered.

The **Analog Emitter**, when powered from its front side, will emit a signal with a configurable strength. \
  \
Right-click it to cycle the output strength.

The **Auto Placer** will try to place the block in its inventory in front of itself. \
  \
It tries to do this every tick, unless it has a redstone signal.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.b: Basic Redstone Interface

The **Basic Redstone Interface** will transmit its own received redstone signal strength to the block it's linked to. \
  \
Use a [Redstone Tool](entry://items/redstone_tool) to link it to a block.
Biome Blocks
**Biome blocks** change color to match the biome they're in.
Biome Radar

The **Biome Radar** is a multiblock structure that helps you find biomes in the world. \
  \
First, you have to actually build the structure:

Then, insert a **Biome Crystal**. There's one for each Biome in the game, and they can be found in basically any chest with loot. \
  \
If the biome exists in the world, the fires on top of the Iron Bars will start blowing in its direction. If that's not enough, you can use a [Location Filter](entry://items/location_filter) on it to set it to the biome's location.
With that, you can craft it with a [Golden Compass](entry://items/golden_compass) to make your way there!
Block Breaker

**Block Breaker** \
  \
The **Block Breaker** will break the block in front of it. It has the equivalent of an unbreakable Iron Pickaxe. \
  \
Blocks broken will be placed into an inventory behind it, if one exists. Otherwise, it will drop to the floor behind it.

It can be disabled with a redstone signal. \
  \
**Diamond Breaker** \
  \
The **Diamond Breaker** can be applied to the Block Breaker to upgrade it, giving it the equivalent of a Diamond Pickaxe.
It can also be enchanted, and any enchantments will actually be applied when breaking blocks!
Block Destabilizer

The **Block Destabilizer** will cause the block in front of it, and all connected blocks of the same type, to fall like Sand when it receives a redstone pulse. \
  \
In its GUI, you can toggle various settings.

When in Lazy Mode, it will remember what block positions to destabilize, even if they're different blocks. \
  \
To set the Lazy Shape, set it to Lazy Mode and then run it once. It'll save the locations of the blocks it destabilizes, and will destabilize specifically those next time regardless of what block is there.

Clicking the Show Lazy Shape button will show cubes where all positions in the Lazy Shape are located. \
  \
The custom render type that this uses is currently not compatible with Sodium! It won't crash, but the Lazy Shape indicators won't be visible through blocks.
Finally, the Forget Lazy Shape button will clear the saved positions.
Block Detector
The **Block Detector** will emit a redstone signal when the block in front of it matches the block stored in its inventory.
Block of Sticks

The **Block of Sticks** breaks itself shortly after being placed. \
  \
The **Returning Block of Sticks** will teleport itself to the nearest player when broken.
Block Teleporter

The **Block Teleporter** allows you to teleport the block in front of itself to another Block Teleporter when powered. \
  \
Use a Location Filter to save the location of one Block Teleporter, and insert it into the inventory of a second Block Teleporter.

When that second Block Teleporter is powered, it will attempt to swap the block in front of itself with the block in front of the linked Block Teleporter. \
  \
Whether or not it works between different dimensions can be configured, and defaults to true.
Bouncy Plate
The **Bouncy Plate** will launch entities that touch it into the air.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.c:
**Chat Detector** \
  \
The **Chat Detector** emits a redstone pulse when the player that places it says a specific phrase in chat. \
  \
Set the phrase in its GUI. It's actually a RegEx field, so you can do more advanced filters. Just typing in the exact phrase is enough, however.

You can also toggle if the message gets canceled or not. \
  \
**Global Chat Detector** \
  \
The **Global Chat Detector** works the same way, but listens to chat messages from every player instead of only its owner.
It can only cancel messages from its owner, however.

Any item entity that touches an **Collection Plate** will be inserted into an adjacent inventory, if possible. \
  \
The order it tries is: Down, North, South, East, East, Up.

Right-clicking a Slime Block with a Shovel will turn it into a **Compressed Slime Block**. Clicking more will compress it further, or reset it. \
  \
Touching a Compressed Slime Block will launch you into the air. The more it's compressed, the higher you bounce.
The **Contact Button** works like a Button, but powers when the block it's aimed at is clicked, rather than when it itself is clicked.
The **Contact Lever** works like a Lever, but toggles when the block it's aimed at is clicked, rather than when it itself is clicked.

The **Corrector Plate** will snap any entity moving on it to be moving along the center of the block. \
  \
That is, they can only move along the plus-shaped path going straight through the middle of the block.

The **Custom Crafting Table** is functionally identical to a regular Crafting Table, but looks like the block it was crafted with. \
  \
For example, 8 Oak Logs around a Crafting Table will make a Crafting Table that looks like an Oak Log.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.d:
**Diaphanous Blocks** look like regular blocks at a distance, but vanishes as you approach, and can be walked through. \
  \
Craft a Diaphanous Block with any other block to set what it looks like.
Crafting a Diaphanous Block by itself will invert it, making it invisible at a distance and solid up close.
The **Directional Accelerator Plate** will push entities touching it in the direction the Plate is aiming.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.e:
The **Ender Bridge** and **Prismarine Ender Bridge**, when powered by redstone, will teleport the entities above it towards the **Ender Anchor** it's aiming at. \
  \
It works through blocks, and across any distance (including unloaded chunks), as long as the Anchor is loaded. It has to be aiming DIRECTLY at the Anchor, as well.

When powered, it will look at every loaded Anchor and find the nearest one that it's aiming at. If there isn't one, it will audibly fail. \
  \
If there *is* an Anchor. it will charge up before activating. Its charge time depends on the distance, as well the tier of Bridge.
The regular Bridge takes 1 tick per block to charge, and the Prismarine Ender Bridge is twice as fast.

The **Ender Mailbox** allows you to send and receive [Ender Letters](entry://items/ender_letter) to and from other players. \
  \
To send a Letter, simply use it on any Mailbox, and it will be sent to the recipient if theirs is not full.
Using any Ender Mailbox will show your own incoming Letters, similar to an Ender Chest.

**Energy Distributor** \
  \
The **Energy Distributor** allows you to evenly distribute FE along a line of adjacent machines it's aimed at. \
  \
Starting from the block in front of it, it will step along a straight path until it reaches a block that cannot store FE. All blocks it finds will be added to its cache.

The Energy Distributor will simulate having an energy storage, which is actually made up of all machines in its cache. Any FE inserted into it is actually inserted into the cached blocks; the same for any FE removed. \
  \
**Ender Energy Distributor** \
  \
The **Ender Energy Distributor** works similarly, but uses 8 [Location Filters](entry://items/location_filter) to specify the machines in its cache.

The **Entity Detector** emits a redstone signal when an entity matching its filter is within its detection area. \
  \
In its GUI you can set the radius in each dimension, if the signal is inverted or not, and specify what type of entity to detect.

You can choose to detect:
- All Entities
- Living Entities
- Animals
- Monsters
- Players
- Items
- Custom \
  \
When in Custom mode, it will use an inserted [Entity Filter](entry://items/entity_filter).

The **Extraction Plate** moves items from an inventory on its input side toward its output side. \
  \
If an inventory is on the output side, the items are inserted into it. Otherwise, they are dropped into the world in that direction.
Right-click a side of the Plate to set the output direction. Sneak right-click anywhere on the Plate to cycle the input direction.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.f:
**Fertilized Dirt** does not need to be hydrated, cannot be trampled, and grows crops 3 times faster. \
  \
You still have to till it with a Hoe before seeds can be planted, however.

The **Filtered Redirector Plate** redirects entities based on their type. \
  \
Entities entering from either end travel straight across by default. An entity matching the left filter is redirected to the left, while an entity matching the right filter is redirected to the right.
Right-click the Plate to open its filter screen, then place an [Entity Filter](entry://items/entity_filter) in either slot.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.g:
**Glowing Mushrooms** can be found growing in caves. \
  \
Any brewing recipe that would accept Glowstone Dust can also accept Glowing Mushrooms.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.i: Igniter

The **Igniter** can be used to light a fire in front of itself, when given a redstone signal. \
  \
It has 3 modes, set in its GUI:
- Toggle: Lights when powered, extinguishes when unpowered
- Keep Ignited: Keeps the fire lit while powered, does nothing when unpowered
- Ignite: Lights when powered, does nothing when unpowered
Imbuing Station

The **Imbuing Station** is used to create Imbues. \
  \
Ingredients that go in the outer slots can go in any order, but the center ingredient must always go in the center slot.
The center slot can be accessed from the top face, the outer slots can be accessed from the sides, and the output slot can be accessed from the bottom.
Inventory Rerouter

The **Inventory Rerouter** exposes the sides of an adjacent inventory from a more convenient location. \
  \
Place it so that its green face points toward the target inventory. Each of the other five faces can independently access any side of that inventory.

Right-click one of the exposed faces to cycle which side of the inventory it accesses. The colored overlay shows the selected side. \
  \
This is useful when a machine needs to interact with a specific face of an inventory that would otherwise be inaccessible.

For example, place it so the block is facing the back of a Furnace. Cycle the side of the Rerouter until it displays a U, for "Up". Any items inserted into that face will actually be inserted into the top face of the Furnace.
Inventory Tester

The **Inventory Tester** must be placed on an inventory, and stores an item in itself. \
  \
It will emit a redstone signal if the inventory is capable of accepting that item.

It also checks the *side* of the inventory it's attached to. If placed on top of a Furnace, it will only work if the Furnace can accept the item into its top. \
  \
Because of that, you may want to also use the [Inventory Rerouter](entry://blocks/inventory_rerouter).
You can invert it in its GUI, so it emits a signal when the inventory *can't* accept the item.
Iron Dropper

The **Iron Dropper** is an upgrade to the regular Dropper, with a handful of extra features. \
  \
Inside it are 4 buttons to cycle its various settings.

Redstone:
- Eject when pulsed
- Eject while powered
- Eject always \
  \
Pickup delay:
- 20 ticks
- 5 ticks
- 0 ticks

Trajectory:
- Random
- Straight \
  \
Effects:
- Particles and sound
- Sound only
- Particles only
- None
Item Collector

The **Item Collector** can be placed on any inventory, and it will collect item entities in a 3 block radius around itself. \
  \
That's a 7x7x7 cube centered on the Collector.
Item Rejuvenator Plate
Any item entity that touches an **Item Rejuvenator Plate** will have its despawn timer reset to 4 minutes and its age reset.
Item Sealer Plate
Any item entity that touches an **Item Sealer Plate** will be prevented from being picked up for 30 seconds.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.l: **Lapis Glass** is solid for players, but allows everything else to pass through.

The **Lapis Lamp**, when provided a redstone signal, will give off false light. \
  \
That is, mob spawning and other game logic will treat the area is if it were not lit, but players will see light.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.m:
The **Moon Phase Detector** emits a redstone signal strength proportional to the phase of the moon. \
  \
It emits a full signal during a full moon, and no signal during a new moon.
You can invert this by right-clicking it.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.n:
The **Nature Core** structure can be found randomly around the overworld, with a Nature Chest nearby full of goodies. \
  \
The Nature Core can also do these things randomly:
- Convert nearby Sand into Dirt/Grass
- Spawn an animal nearby
- Bone Meal nearby crops
- Plant Saplings nearby
- Repair the structure around it

The **Notification Interface** will send its owner a customizable notification when it receives a redstone pulse. \
  \
You can set the notifications title, body, and icon in its GUI.
Server admins can also use the command `/ii notify    ` to send notifications to players.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.o: The **Online Detector** emits a redstone signal when the chosen player is logged onto the server. Set the player by typing their username into its GUI.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.p: Peace Candle

The **Peace Candle** prevents hostile mobs from spawning within a radius around it. By default, this radius is a single chunk. That is, it effects a 3x3 chunk area centered on itself. \
  \
It can be disabled with a redstone signal.
Peace Candles can be found in certain Village temples. Where there would be a Brewing Stand, you can sometimes instead find a Peace Candle.
Pitcher Plant

The **Pitcher Plant** generates an infinite amount of water. It can be found in wet biomes in the overworld. \
  \
Clicking a bucket or other fluid receptacle will fill it with Water.
Placing it adjacent to a tank will fill the tank with water, at a configurable speed. You can also pipe water from it, also at a configurable speed.
Platforms

**Platforms** \
  \
**Platforms** are solid from the top, but not from the bottom or sides. \
  \
Additionally, sneaking will allow you to fall through them.

**Super Lubricant Platform** \
  \
The **Super Lubricant Platform** works the same, but works like other [Super Lubricated blocks](entry://blocks/super_lubricated_blocks) and negates all friction. \
  \
This makes it very useful for transporting items.

**Filtered Super Lubricant Platform** \
  \
The **Filtered Super Lubricant Platform** works the same, but can hold an [Item Filter](entry://items/item_filter). \
  \
Anything matching the filter will fall through the platform.
Player Interface

The **Player Interface** allows you to interact with the owner's inventory via pipes and the like. \
  \
Each face aims at a different part of the inventory:
- Top: armor
- Bottom: hotbar
- North: offhand
- Others: main inventory
Processing Plate

The **Processing Plate** combines the functions of the [Collection Plate](./collection_plate) and the [Extraction Plate](./extraction_plate). It can collect dropped items into the inventory below it while independently moving items from another adjacent inventory toward its configured output. \
  \
Like the other Plates, it is placed on top of a supporting block and has no collision box. Entities can move through the thin Plate, and dropped items are processed when they touch it.

**Collecting dropped items** \
  \
When a dropped item entity touches the Processing Plate, the Plate attempts to insert the stack into the inventory directly below it. \
  \
This collection direction is always **Down**. It is separate from the configurable extraction and output sides described below.

If the inventory can accept only part of the stack, the accepted items are inserted and the remainder stays in the world. If it cannot accept any of the stack, the item remains unchanged. If the entire stack is inserted, the item entity is removed. \
  \
**Extracting items from an inventory** \
  \
The Processing Plate also performs an automatic inventory transfer twice per second. Each transfer attempt checks the inventory on the configured **extraction side**.

The extraction side may be Down, North, East, South, West, or Up. The Plate accesses the face of that inventory which points toward the Plate, so the sided insertion and extraction rules of machines and other inventories are respected. \
  \
The Plate checks the inventory's slots in order. When it finds an item stack that can be extracted and sent to the output, it moves up to 64 items and finishes that transfer attempt. It therefore transfers from at most one slot per attempt.

**Sending extracted items to the output** \
  \
The **output side** may be North, East, South, or West. \
  \
If an inventory is adjacent to the output side, the Plate inserts the extracted items into the face pointing toward the Plate. It extracts only as many items as the output can accept.

If there is no inventory on the output side, the extracted stack is dropped just beyond the edge of the Plate and pushed gently in the output direction. If an output inventory unexpectedly leaves a remainder during the transfer, that remainder is dropped and pushed in the same way. \
  \
The marking on top of the Plate indicates its current output direction.

**Configuration** \
  \
The Processing Plate has no menu. Configure it with an empty hand: \
  \
- **Right-click** to cycle the extraction side.
- **Sneak right-click** to cycle the horizontal output side.

A status message displays the newly selected side after each interaction. \
  \
When placed, the output points in the direction the player was facing. The extraction side points in the opposite direction.

**Example** \
  \
Place a Processing Plate on a chest, with a furnace to its north and another chest to its east. Set the extraction side to North and the output side to East. \
  \
The Plate now performs two independent jobs:

1. Dropped items moving over the Plate are inserted into the chest below. 2. Items are extracted from the furnace to the north and inserted into the chest to the east. \
  \
Changing the extraction or output side does not change where dropped items are collected; dropped items always go into the inventory below.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.q: **Quartz Glass** allows players to pass through, but is solid for everything else.

The **Quartz Lamp**, when provided a redstone signal, will give off light that cannot be seen. \
  \
That is, mob spawning and other game logic will treat the area is if it were lit, but players will not see any light.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.r:
The **Rain Shield** prevents rain from falling in a radius around it. By default, this radius is 5 chunks. \
  \
It can be disabled with a redstone signal.
The **Rainbow Lamp** glows a different color depending on the redstone signal strength it's receiving.

The **Redirector Plate** has two active sides. Any entity that moves onto one active side will be teleported to the other. \
  \
Right-click to set the first active side, and sneak right-click to set the other.

The **Redstone Observer** gives off the same redstone signal output as the block it's linked to. \
  \
Use a [Redstone Tool](entry://items/redstone_tool) to link it to a block.

The **Redstone Plate** redirects entities entering from its input side to one of two output sides. \
  \
When the Plate receives a redstone signal, entities take the powered output. Otherwise, they take the unpowered output.
Right-click an unused side of the Plate to set the powered output. Sneak right-click to set the unpowered output.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.s: Sakanade Spores

**Sakanade Spores** can be found on the bottom of Large Brown Mushroom caps. When touched, Sakanade Spores will inflict the Collapse effect to entities. \
  \
For players, the Collapse effect inverts their movement and mouse controls.
For mobs, it instead confuses their pathfinding, causing them to move erratically.
Shock Absorber

The **Shock Absorber** negates all fall damage when landed on. \
  \
Additionally, it will emit a redstone signal proportional the the distance fallen.
Sided Block of Redstone
The **Sided Block of Redstone** emits a full signal on one face, and nothing on the others.
Slime Cube

The **Slime Cube**, when unpowered, causes Slimes to spawn in a radius around it. By default, this radius is 1 chunk (so a 3x3 chunk area centered on itself). \
  \
When powered, it instead prevents Slimes from spawning in that same area.
Spectre Coils

**Regular Coils** \
  \
**Spectre Coils** allow you to extract energy from your [Spectre Energy Buffer](entry://blocks/spectre_energy_injector) wirelessly. \
  \
Each tier pulls a higher RF/t. Place the Coil directly on the machine you want to charge.

**Generator Coils** \
  \
The **Spectre Coil Nr. 245** generates a small amount of RF/t for free, rather than using your Spectre Energy Buffer. It can be rarely found in dungeon chests. \
  \
The **Genesis Spectre Coil** is creative-only, and generates an infinite amount of RF/t.
Spectre Energy Injector

Every player has their own Spectre Energy Buffer, which acts sort of like an Ender Chest for FE. By default, it can store 1,000,000 FE. \
  \
Energy can be inserted into a player's Buffer via the **Spectre Energy Injector**. Whoever placed the Injector is whose Buffer gets filled.
You cannot extract from the Injector. Instead, you'll have to use either a Spectre Coil or a [Spectre Charger](entry://items/spectre_charger).
Spectre Lens

The **Spectre Lens** can be placed on a Beacon to allow it to effect you from any distance, as long as you're in the same dimension. \
  \
It only effects the player who placed the Lens.
Naturally, it only works while the chunk it's in is loaded.
Spectre Sapling

**Spectre Saplings** grow into a translucent Spectre trees. \
  \
**Spectre Leaves** have a chance of dropping [Ectoplasm](entry://items/ectoplasm), allowing it to be farmed.
Create a Spectre Sapling by using Ectoplasm on any other Sapling.
Super Lubricated Blocks
**Super Lubricant Stone** and **Super Lubricant Ice** fully negate friction, allowing entities to slide over them without slowing down.
book.irregular_implements.guide.blocks.t:
**Trigger Glass** is usually solid, but temporarily becomes non-solid when it receives a redstone pulse. \
  \
This effect propagates to all adjacent Trigger Glass blocks, within a distance.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.be:
**Beans** can be found growing around the overworld in any biome that is neither hot, cold, dry, nor sparse. \
  \
They can be planted on any dirt-like blocks.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.bi:
The **Biome Capsule** and **Biome Painter** are used together to allow you to change the biome of a location. \
  \
Throw the Biome Capsule on the ground, and it will absorb points of the biome it's in.

Hold the Biome Painter in-hand to see what blocks nearby are not the same biome as the first non-empty Capsule in your inventory. Right-click the Painter on those blocks to change it, spending the biome points.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.bl: The **Blaze and Steel** lights a much more aggressive fire, which burns and spreads much faster.

The **Block Mover** can pick up and place down a single block, including its block entity. \
  \
It cannot move blocks that have the block tag `#irregular_implements:block_mover_blacklist`.

The **Block Replacer** allows you to quickly replace blocks in the world with blocks stored in the item. \
  \
To store a block in the Replacer, right-click the block stack in your inventory onto the slot the Block Replacer is in, the same way you would use a Bundle.

You can empty the Replacer by right-clicking the Replacer stack onto an empty inventory slot. \
  \
Using the item on a block in the world will break that block and place a random stored block in its place.
Blocks with the block tag `#irregular_implements:block_replacer_blacklist` cannot be replaced with the Block Replacer.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.bo:
The **Bottle of Air** can be "drunk" to refill your air supply when underwater. \
  \
It can only be found in chests in Ocean Monuments.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.ch:
The **Chunk Analyzer** can be used to see the blocks that make up the chunk you're currently standing in. \
  \
The list of all blocks in the chunk, as well as their counts, will be displayed in your chat.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.di:
There is a **Divining Rod** for each ore (that is, any block/item that has a tag beginning with `#c:ores/`). When held in-hand, nearby ores of that type will be visible through walls. \
  \
The custom render type that this uses is currently not compatible with Sodium! It won't crash, but the ores won't be highlighted.

The same recipe can be used for any ore type, just substituting the actual ore itself. It follows this pattern: \
  \
``` OSO SES S S ``` where `O` is the ore block, `S` is a Stick, and `E` is a Spider Eye.
You can also craft a universal Divining Rod that works for all ores!
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.dr:
The **Drop Filter** can hold an [Item Filter](entry://items/item_filter), and will prevent items matching the filter from entering your inventory. \
  \
The **Voiding Drop Filter** does the same, but instead deletes the items matching the filter entirely.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.ec:
**Ectoplasm** is a material that drops when Spirits are killed. \
  \
Spirits have a chance of spawning any time a mob dies. The chance increases the closer it is to the full moon, and increases further if the Ender Dragon has ever been killed on the server.
Spirits can only be damaged via magic. This includes Splash Potions, enchanted items, and certain other items like the Spectre Sword.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.em:
The **Emerald Compass** aims at a bound player, assuming they're online and in the same dimension as you. There are two ways to bind the Compass to a player: \
  \
1. Simply right-click the Compass on them. 2. Craft the Compass together with a [Player Filter](irregular_implements:player_filter).
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.en:
The **Ender Bucket** can be used on a flowing fluid, and it will gather the nearest fluid source from a distance. \
  \
The **Reinforced Ender Bucket** works the same, but can also store up to 10 fluid sources at once.

The **Ender Letter** allows you to send items to other players more easily. It can store up to 9 stacks inside itself. \
  \
In its GUI, type the recipient's username. Then, simply use it on any [Ender Mailbox](entry://blocks/ender_mailbox). If the recipient's Mailbox is not full, it will be placed inside it.

The **Entity Filter** allows you to filter based on entity type. \
  \
To set the entity type, simply use the Filter on the desired entity. Sneak right-click to set it to Player.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.es:
The **Escape Rope** can be used to quickly get out of caves. \
  \
Hold right-click, and it will try to find a path to the nearest block that can see the sky. If a path is found, you will be teleported there instantly.
If no path is found, the Rope will be dropped from your hands.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.ev:
The **Evil Tear** can be used to make an Artificial End Portal. \
  \
Make the following structure (the End Rod is 3 blocks above the Obsidian, 4 above the End Stone), and then use the Tear on the End Rod.
An End Portal will grow in the ring, and will function exactly as expected. Breaking any of these blocks will break the Portal.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.fl:
The **Floo Pouch** can store up to 128 [Floo Powder](entry://items/floo_powder). \
  \
Unlike Floo Powder, it works from anywhere in your inventory rather than just in your hand.
Sneak right-click the Pouch to fill it with all the Powder in your inventory.
**Floo Powder** is the fuel that allows you to use Floo teleportation. It must be held in-hand when the destination is said in chat.

**Floo Signs** are used to create Floo Fireplaces. Using the Sign on Bricks placed in the world will convert them all to Floo Bricks. \
  \
If the Floo Sign has been renamed in an Anvil, the Fireplace will be named the same. If not, the Fireplace will have no name and cannot be teleported from, not to.

**Floo Tokens** allow you to use Floo teleportation from anywhere in the world. \
  \
Throw it on the ground and wait several seconds. It will spawn a Temporary Floo Fireplace, which will allow you to teleport to any named Floo Fireplace.
While this will not take any [Floo Powder](entry://items/floo_powder), it *will* use up the Token.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.go:
The **Golden Compass** aims at a bound location, assuming it's in the same dimension as the user. \
  \
Bind the location by crafting the Compass together with a set [Location Filter](entry://items/location_filter).

**Golden Eggs** spawn Golden Chickens when thrown. Instead of laying Eggs, Golden Chickens lay Gold Ingots. \
  \
Golden Eggs can be found in Bean Pods.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.gr:
**Grass Seeds** can be used on dirt blocks to turn them into Grass. \
  \
**Colored Grass Seeds** do the same, but make Colored Grass.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.im:
**Imbues** are special potions that are created in the [Imbuing Station](entry://blocks/imbuing_station). They provide powerful long-lasting effects when consumed. \
  \
However, you can only have a single Imbue at a time. Drinking a new Imbue will replace your current one.

**Available Imbues** \
  \
- **Fire Imbue**: Melee attacks set targets on fire.
- **Poison Imbue**: Melee attacks inflict Poison II.
- **Wither Imbue**: Melee attacks inflict Wither II.
- **Experience Imbue**: Double experience from slain mobs.
- **Spectre Imbue**: 10% chance to completely negate incoming damage.
- **Collapse Imbue**: Melee attacks inflict [Collapse](entry://blocks/sakanade_spores).
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.it:
The **Item Filter** has a list of up to 9 items, and can serve as either a Whitelist or a Blacklist. Toggle this using the button on the far right of the GUI. \
  \
Above each filled slot is two buttons.

The left button allows you to toggle if the slot is an Item Filter or a Tag Filter. For example, putting a Stick in the slot will by default make it filter for the `minecraft:stick` item. Changing it to a Tag Filter will make it filter one of Stick's item tags. \
  \
The right button's function changes depending on if the slot is an Item Filter or a Tag Filter.

For Item Filter slots, it toggles whether or not the item must match the data components (like enchantments, custom names, etc) of the item in the slot. \
  \
For Tag Filter slots, it cycles which of the item's tags to filter for.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.la:
The **Lava Charm** can be worn as a Curio, and adds a temporary lava shield. It is visible above your armor bar. \
  \
While the shield is full, you will be completely immune to lava damage. Note that it does not protect you from fire damage, only lava damage.

It may be wise to also invest in an [Obsidian Skull](entry://items/obsidian_skull) to protect against fire damage. \
  \
Lava Charms can be found rarely in dungeon chests, and more commonly in Nether Fortress chests.

**Lava Waders** combine the effects of the [Obsidian Water Walking Boots](entry://items/obsidian_water_walking_boots) and the [Lava Charm](entry://items/lava_charm), as well as allowing you to walk on Lava. \
  \
Get them by combining the two in an Anvil.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.lo:
The **Location Filter** allows you to set a location, which can then be used by other items and blocks to reference that location. \
  \
Set the location by using the Filter on the block.

**Lotus Blossoms** can be eaten to give the player a handful of experience. Sneaking will consume the entire stack. \
  \
Lotus Blossoms can be found in cold biomes, and can be farmed using Lotus Seeds planted on any dirt block.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.lu:
**Luminous Powder** can be crafted with any item to make it glow in the dark. \
  \
You can remove it by crafting the item with a Water Bucket.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.ma:
**Lesser Magic Bean** \
  \
**Lesser Magic Beans** can be planted to make a Bean Stalk that grows upwards until it's blocked by something. It can be climbed like a ladder! \
  \
**Magic Bean** \
  \
The non-lesser **Magic Bean** is a much more powerful version. They grow much, much faster, and will break (almost) any block in their way.

Once it reaches the top of the world (or if it wouldn't be able to grow further), it will place a **Bean Pod** at its top. Break it open to collect some rare loot! \
  \
The Magic Bean cannot be crafted. Instead, it can be found in dungeon loot and [Nature Core](entry://blocks/nature_core) chests.

The **Magic Hood**, when worn, will hide your nameplate and potion particles. \
  \
It can be found in dungeon chests.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.ob:
The **Obsidian Skull** has a chance of negating fire damage while in your inventory. \
  \
The more damage that would have been taken, the higher the chance of negation. The exact formula is:

``` (damage ^ 3) / 100 ``` \
  \
The **Obsidian Skull Ring** does the exact same, but can be worn in a Curio slot.

**Obsidian Water Walking Boots** combine the effects of the [Water Walking Boots](entry://items/water_walking_boots) and the [Obsidian Skull](entry://items/obsidian_skull). \
  \
Get them by combining the two in an Anvil.
Note that this does not let you walk on Lava! You'll have to use the [Lava Waders](entry://items/lava_waders) for that.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.pl:
The **Player Filter** allows you to filter based on a specific player. \
  \
To set it, simply use the Filter on the desired player. Sneak right-click to set it to yourself.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.po:
The **Portable Ender Bridge** can be used to teleport to [Ender Anchors](entry://blocks/ender_bridge). \
  \
While held in the hand, you'll be able to see nearby Ender Bridges through blocks. Simply right-click while looking at an Ender Anchor to teleport to it.
The custom render type that this uses is currently not compatible with Sodium! It won't crash, but the Ender Anchors won't be visible through walls.

The **Portkey** is used to teleport whoever picks it up. \
  \
Right-click the Portkey on a block to set its destination. Then, throw it on the ground. After a short delay, it will activate.

Anyone who touches the activated Portkey will be teleported instantly to the destination, assuming it's in the same dimension. \
  \
You can craft the Portkey with any other item to disguise it, making it look like the item it was crafted with.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.re:
The **Redstone Activator** will provide a short redstone pulse when used on a block. \
  \
Sneak right-click to cycle the duration between 2, 20, and 100 ticks.

The **Redstone Remote** acts like the [Redstone Activator](entry://items/redstone_activator), but can be used from a distance. \
  \
It can have up to 9 stored locations. Sneak right-click it to open its GUI, and insert set [Location Filters](entry://items/location_filter). You can place an item in the slot above to give its button an icon.
Right-click while not sneaking to access the location buttons. Click the button to pulse its location for a short duration.

The **Redstone Tool** is used to link certain wireless redstone blocks to other locations. \
  \
First, use it on the linkable block, so the Tool knows what's being linked. Then, use it on the destination block you want it to be linked to.

While holding the Redstone Tool, you'll be able to see all links nearby through walls. \
  \
The custom render type that this uses is currently not compatible with Sodium! It won't crash, but the line won't be visible  through blocks.

The Redstone Tool can be used on the following blocks:
- [Basic Redstone Interface](entry://blocks/basic_redstone_interface)
- [Redstone Observer](entry://blocks/redstone_observer)
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.sp:
The **Spectre Anchor** can be crafted together with any item to allow you to retain it after death. \
  \
After this, the Anchor is removed from the item.

**Spectre Chargers** are used to charge items in your inventory with FE from your [Spectre Energy Buffer](entry://blocks/spectre_energy_injector). \
  \
While active, it will charge every item in your inventory, including armor and Curio slots.
Each tier charges faster than the last. The **Genesis Spectre Charger** is creative only, and does not use your Spectre Energy Buffer's energy.

**Spectre Armor** is equivalent to Diamond, with higher durability and enchantability. \
  \
Wearing a full set also makes you slightly transparent!

The **Spectre Illuminator** can be used on a block to fully light up the chunk it's in. \
  \
It will place an entity that slowly floats upwards, aiming to be just above the highest block in the chunk.
This can be undone by either right-clicking the Illuminator entity, or by using **Blackout Powder** in the chunk.

The **Spectre Key** can be used to teleport to a private room in another dimension, unique to each player. \
  \
Once there, you can build and store items safely, and they'll remain there. Leave by either using the Spectre Key again or by clicking one of the Spectre Core blocks on the floor.

The room is 16 blocks wide and deep, and defaults to being 2 blocks tall internally. You can expand it vertically by using [Ectoplasm](entry://items/ectoplasm) on the Spectre Core blocks. \
  \
Each Ectoplasm increases the height by one. It will use the entire stack at once.

The **Spectre Sword** is comparable to a Diamond Sword, with higher durability and enchantability. \
  \
It increases your entity interaction range by 3 blocks, and can be used to kill [Spirits](entry://items/ectoplasm).

The **Spectre Pickaxe**, **Spectre Axe**, and **Spectre Shovel** are comparable to their Diamond counterparts, with higher durability and enchantability. \
  \
They increase your block interaction range by 3 blocks.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.st:
The **Stable Ender Pearl** is used to teleport a bound player in a more controlled way. \
  \
Right-click the Pearl to bind it to you. After seven seconds of sitting on the ground as an item entity, it will teleport the bound player to its location, and break.
If there is no bound player, it will instead teleport a random nearby entity within 10 blocks.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.su:
The **Summoning Pendulum** can be used to store up to 5 (by default) entities, and place them back down later. \
  \
Right-click the Pendulum on an entity to pick it up, right-click on a block to place it down.

The **Super Lubricant Tincture** can be crafted with any boot item to make them completely negate friction when worn, while below a certain speed. \
  \
You can craft lubricated boots with a Water Bottle to wash them of the lubricant.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.vo: The **Void Stone** will delete any items inserted into its GUI.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.wa:
**Water Walking Boots** allow you to walk on water. Wow! \
  \
They do not work while already underwater, and are disabled while sneaking.

Note that walking on water means that you can also LAND on water, causing fall damage! \
  \
They can only be found in chests in Ocean Monuments.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.we:
**Weather Eggs** change the weather when thrown. \
  \
There are 3 types: Sunny, Rainy, and Stormy.

Naturally, throwing a Sunny Egg will clear the weather, a Rainy Egg will cause rain, and a Stormy Egg will cause a thunderstorm. \
  \
Throwing an Egg that matches the current weather will do nothing.
book.irregular_implements.guide.items.wh:
The **White Stone** has the power to prevent your death once while charged. Doing so fully discharges the item. \
  \
Charge the item by exposing it to the light of the full moon, either by dropping it on the ground or holding it while standing outside. The moon must also be at its peak.
It can be rarely found in dungeon chests.
book.irregular_implements.guide.name: Irregular Implements Instructional Index
command.irregular_implements.spectre_ene: %s has %s FE in their Spectre Energy buffer.
Set %s's Spectre Energy buffer to %s FE.
death.fell.accident.fluid_fall.boot: %s splattered against the surface of %s because they were wearing %s
death.fell.accident.fluid_fall.generic: %s splattered against the surface of %s because they could walk on it
enchantment.irregular_implements.magneti: Teleports fresh item drops towards you
info.irregular_implements.accelerator_pl: Entities moving on this Plate are sped up slightly, to a limit.
info.irregular_implements.advanced_item_:
Collects items in a configurable radius and inserts it into the inventory it's placed on.

You can also insert an Item Filter for more control.
info.irregular_implements.advanced_redst:
Powers up to 9 linked blocks with the Redstone signal it's receiving.

Use a Redstone Tool to link it to blocks.
A Redstone Repeater that can have both its Step Up and Step Down delays configured.
A Redstone Torch that can have its Powered and Unpowered output strengths configured
info.irregular_implements.analog_emitter: Emits a Redstone signal with a configurable strength when the front face is powered.
info.irregular_implements.auto_placer:
Places blocks in front of it from its inventory.

Can be disabled with a Redstone signal.
info.irregular_implements.basic_redstone:
Powers the linked block with the Redstone signal it's receiving.

Use a Redstone Tool to link it to a block.
info.irregular_implements.bean_pod:
Found at the top of a grown Magic Bean.

Contains loot!
info.irregular_implements.biome_blocks: Changes color to match the biome.
info.irregular_implements.biome_capsule:
Throw on the ground, and it will capture the biome it lands in.

Used in conjunction with the Biome Painter.
info.irregular_implements.biome_crystal: Found in dungeon chests, can be inserted into a Biome Radar to locate a biome.
info.irregular_implements.biome_painter:
Use it on a block, and it will paint the biome of the first Biome Capsule in your inventory.

The radius can be configured.
info.irregular_implements.biome_radar:
Insert a Biome Crystal and provide a Redstone signal, and it will attempt to find the Crystal's biome.

If it succeeds, it will spawn particles aiming in its direction.

Using a Paper on it will create a Location Filter for the biome.
info.irregular_implements.blackout_powde: Removes the Spectre Illuminator in the chunk it's used in.
info.irregular_implements.blaze_and_stee: Lights a much more aggressive Fire.
info.irregular_implements.block_breaker:
Breaks blocks in front of it with the effectiveness of an Iron Pickaxe. Drops are inserted into the inventory behind it, or dropped.

Can be disabled with a Redstone signal.

Can be upgraded with a Diamond Breaker.
info.irregular_implements.block_destabil:
When given a Redstone pulse, scans the blocks in front of it.

It then gives the nearest 50 connected blocks gravity, making them fall.

You can set it to "lazy" mode, which makes it remember the shape, and only destabilize those blocks.
info.irregular_implements.block_mover:
Use on a block to pick it up, and use it again to place it.

Can be used on blocks with Block Entities, like Chests and machines.
info.irregular_implements.block_of_stick: Cheap building material that automatically breaks after 10 seconds.
info.irregular_implements.block_replacer:
Stores up to 9 stacks of blocks. When used on a block, it gets replaced with a random stored block.

Sneak right-click to open its inventory.
info.irregular_implements.bottle_of_air:
Refills your breath.

Can be found in Ocean Monuments.
info.irregular_implements.bouncy_plate: Entities on this Plate are propelled upwards.
info.irregular_implements.chat_detector: Emits a Redstone pulse if the block's owner sends a chat message containing some specified text.
info.irregular_implements.chunk_analyzer: When used, shows you all the blocks and entities in the chunk you're in.
info.irregular_implements.collection_pla:
Dropped item entities that pass over this Plate attempt to insert into adjacent inventories.

The order it tries is: Down, North, South, East, West, Up
info.irregular_implements.compressed_sli:
Create by clicking a Slime Block with a Shovel. Can be compressed multiple times.

Launches entities into the air.
info.irregular_implements.contact_button: Acts like a Button, but works when the block in front of it is clicked instead.
info.irregular_implements.contact_lever: Acts like a Lever, but works when the block in front of it is clicked instead.
info.irregular_implements.corrector_plat:
Entities moving on the Plate are centered along the axis they're moving.

For example, if they're moving South, they're teleported to the middle of the North-South axis of the block.
info.irregular_implements.custom_craftin:
Works exactly like a vanilla Crafting Table, except it looks like the block it's made of.

This uses the item tag #irregular_implements:custom_crafting_table_items
info.irregular_implements.diamond_breake:
Apply to a Block Breaker to increase its mining level to equivalent to a Diamond Pickaxe.

Can also be enchanted!
info.irregular_implements.diaphanous_blo:
Looks like another block, but becomes transparent as you approach.

Craft it with any block to set its appearance.

Craft it by itself to invert it, so it starts transparent and becomes opaque.
info.irregular_implements.directional_ac: Entities on this Plate are pushed slightly in the direction the Plate is facing.
info.irregular_implements.divining_rod:
When held in hand, highlights the corresponding ore if it's within 20 blocks of you.

This radius can be configured.
info.irregular_implements.drop_filter: Filters out items that match the contained Item Filters from entering your inventory.
info.irregular_implements.ectoplasm:
Every time an entity dies, it has a chance of spawning a Spirit.

Spirits can only be killed by magic, and they drop Ectoplasm.

Can also be harvested from Spectre Trees.
info.irregular_implements.emerald_compas:
Points to the set player, if they are online.

Set the player by crafting with a Player Filter.
info.irregular_implements.ender_anchor: Destination point for the Ender Bridge or Prismarine Ender Bridge.
info.irregular_implements.ender_bridge:
Upon the Ender Bridge receiving a Redstone Signal, it looks for an Ender Anchor in front of it.

It searches at 20 blocks per second, and then teleports the player standing on top to it.

There's no distance limit, though there can be no blocks between (save for the block directly in front of the Bridge).
info.irregular_implements.ender_bucket: When used on a non-source fluid, it picks up the nearest source.
info.irregular_implements.ender_letter:
Can be used to send items and messages to other players.

Type the name of the player at the top, and insert up to 9 items.

Click an Ender Mailbox, and it will be inserted into their Ender Mailbox if it has room.
info.irregular_implements.ender_mailbox: Allows players to send and receive Ender Letters.
info.irregular_implements.entity_detecto: Emits a Redstone signal if a configured entity is within a configured range.
info.irregular_implements.entity_filter: Allows you to filter by entity type. Do so by using it on an entity.
info.irregular_implements.escape_rope:
Hold right-click to begin searching for the nearest location that can see the sky.

If it finds one, it'll teleport you there.
info.irregular_implements.evil_tear:
Can be used on a specific structure to make an Artificial End Portal.

Place an End Stone, and place an End Rod under it.

4 blocks below it, build a 3x3 of End Stone, with a 5x5 ring of Obsidian one block above it.

Use the Evil Tear on the End Rod to complete the structure.
info.irregular_implements.extraction_pla:
Has an "input" side and an "output" side. Extracts stacks from the input side, and drops or inserts them on the output side, depending on if there's an inventory there.

Right-click with an empty hand to change the output side, and do so while sneaking to change the input side.
info.irregular_implements.fertilized_dir:
Fertilized Dirt does not require hydration, grows crops 3 times faster, and can't be trampled.

You still have to till it with a Hoe to grow crops.
info.irregular_implements.filtered_redir:
Has two "input" sides, and two color-coded "output" sides.

Both output sides have a slot for an Entity Filter, and any entity that enters from the input sides are teleported to the output with a matching Filter.
info.irregular_implements.global_chat_de:
Emits a redstone pulse if any player sends a chat message containing the specified text.

Can have a player whitelist using Player Filterss.
info.irregular_implements.golden_egg:
Spawns a Chicken that lays Gold Ingots rather than Eggs.

Can be found in Bean Pods, which can be found at the top of Bean Stalks grown from Magic Beans.
info.irregular_implements.grass_seeds: Can be planted on Dirt to grow Grass.
info.irregular_implements.igniter:
Sets or extinguishes the block on front of it, depending on the Redstone signal.

Can be set to keep the fire lit.
info.irregular_implements.imbue_collapse:
Inverts your controls.

Why would you want this?
info.irregular_implements.imbue_experien:
Increases experience dropped by entities by 50%%.

Lasts 20 minutes, but you can only have one Imbuement at a time.
info.irregular_implements.imbue_fire:
Sets entities you hit with melee attacks on fire.

Lasts 20 minutes, but you can only have one Imbuement at a time.
info.irregular_implements.imbue_poison:
Inflicts Poison II on entities you hit with melee attacks.

Lasts 20 minutes, but you can only have one Imbuement at a time.
info.irregular_implements.imbue_spectre:
Gives you a configurable chance to fully negate damage.

Lasts 20 minutes, but you can only have one Imbuement at a time.
info.irregular_implements.imbue_wither:
Inflicts Wither II on entities you hit with melee attacks.

Lasts 20 minutes, but you can only have one Imbuement at a time.
info.irregular_implements.inventory_rero:
Each side can be configured to "point" to one side of the block in front.

For example, setting this block's bottom face to "U" will and then inserting items into it will try to insert those items into the top face of the block in front of it.

Also allows for extracting.
info.irregular_implements.inventory_test:
When placed on an inventory, constantly simulates attempting to insert a configured Item Stack.

If the simulation would succeed, it emits a Redstone signal. You can invert this behavior.
info.irregular_implements.iron_dropper:
An upgraded Dropper, where the following can be configured:

• Item pickup delay
• Item motion randomness
• Particle/Sound toggle
• Redstone control
info.irregular_implements.item_collector: Collects items in a 3 block radius and inserts it into the inventory it's placed on.
info.irregular_implements.item_filter: Allows you to filter Item Stacks. Do so in its GUI.
info.irregular_implements.item_rejuvenat: Dropped item entities that pass over this Plate have their despawn timer set to 4 minutes.
info.irregular_implements.item_sealer_pl: Dropped item entities that pass over this Plate cannot be picked up for 30 seconds.
info.irregular_implements.lapis_glass: Solid for players, not solid for anything else.
info.irregular_implements.lava_charm:
Adds a temporary lava shield, visible above your armor bar. This prevents taking damage from Lava, but does NOT prevent you from lighting on fire!

Lasts about 10 seconds.
info.irregular_implements.lava_waders:
Combines the effects of Obsidian Water Walking Boots and a Lava Charm.

Additionally allows you to stand on lava.
info.irregular_implements.lesser_magic_b:
Can be planted on any block, and grows into a bean stalk.

Bean Stalk blocks can be climbed faster than Ladders.
info.irregular_implements.location_filte:
An item representation of a position in the world.

Set by either using it on a block.
info.irregular_implements.lotus_blossom:
Grants experience when consumed.

Sneak to consume the entire stack.
info.irregular_implements.lotus_seeds:
Can be planted to grow Lotus Blossoms.

Lotus plants can be found in cold biomes.
info.irregular_implements.lubricant: Completely frictionless. Anything moving on it will retain its momentum.
info.irregular_implements.luminous_powde: Can be crafted onto items to make them glow in the dark.
info.irregular_implements.magic_bean:
Can be planted on any block, and grows a bean stalk that reaches the sky.

The top of the bean stalk has treasures.
info.irregular_implements.magic_hood: Disables your name plate and potion particles.
info.irregular_implements.magnetic_encha: Teleports fresh item drops towards you.
info.irregular_implements.moon_phase_det: Emits a Redstone signal depending on the current moon phase.
info.irregular_implements.notification_i: Sends a configurable toast notification to the block's owner when a Redstone signal is received.
info.irregular_implements.obsidian_skull:
Has a chance of negating fire damage.

The chance is higher the lower the damage would be.
Works like the Obsidian Skull, but can be worn as a Curio.
info.irregular_implements.obsidian_water: Combines the effects of the Obsidian Skull and Water Walking Boots.
info.irregular_implements.online_detecto: Emits a Redstone signal if the specified player is online.
info.irregular_implements.peace_candle:
Prevents natural mob spawns in a 3 chunk radius.

Replaces the Brewing Stand in one third of Village Temples.
info.irregular_implements.pitcher_plant:
Acts as an infinite water source.

Slowly fills adjacent fluid containers.
info.irregular_implements.player_filter:
Acts like an Entity Filter, but specifically for the player set.

Set by using it in your hand.
info.irregular_implements.player_interfa: Exposes the inventory of the block's owner, as if it was the block's inventory.
info.irregular_implements.portable_ender:
Use while looking at an Ender Anchor to teleport to it.

Has a configurable range, defaulting to 300. Requires direct line of sight.
info.irregular_implements.portkey:
Use on a block to set a destination, then throw it on the ground.

After 5 seconds, anyone who picks it up will be teleported to the destination.

You can craft it with any other item to disguise it!
info.irregular_implements.potion_vaporiz:
Allows you to fill a room with a potion effect.

Insert Potions and Furnace fuel, and it will scan the area in front of it to check if it's an enclosed area.

If it is, it'll fill it with the potion effect.
info.irregular_implements.prismarine_end:
Upon the Prismarine Ender Bridge receiving a Redstone Signal, it looks for an Ender Anchor in front of it (with no distance limit, though it must be loaded, and no other blocks can be in the way).

It searches at 200 blocks per second, and then teleports the player standing on top to it.

There's no distance limit, though there can be no blocks between (save for the block directly in front of the Bridge).
info.irregular_implements.processing_pla:
Inserts dropped items passing over it into the inventory below. It also extracts items from a configurable side and inserts or drops them on its output side.

Right-click with an empty hand to change the extraction side. Sneak while doing so to change the output side.
info.irregular_implements.rain_shield: Prevents rain in a 5 chunk radius.
info.irregular_implements.rainbow_lamp:
Changes color depending on the Redstone signal strength.

Only the texture changes, the light stays the same color.
info.irregular_implements.redirector_pla: Has two "enabled" sides. Entities that enter from one side are sent to the other side.
info.irregular_implements.redstone_activ:
Using it on a block will give it a temporary Redstone signal.

Use it on the air to change the duration.
info.irregular_implements.redstone_obser:
Emits the same Redstone signal as a linked block.

Use a Redstone Tool to link it to a block.
info.irregular_implements.redstone_plate:
Entities moving over this plate are redirected in a configurable direction.

If powered, they instead move forward.
info.irregular_implements.redstone_remot:
Allows you to temporarily power one of nine blocks from a distance.

Sneak right-click it to open its GUI, where you can place up to 9 Location Filters. Under each you can set an item to represent that position.

Right-click normally to see all the positions it can power.
info.irregular_implements.redstone_tool:
Used to bind the Redstone Observer or Redstone Interfaces to blocks.

Sneak right-click on the Observer/Interface, then click on the block to bind/unbind it.

Also shows the signal strength of the block you're looking at!
info.irregular_implements.reinforced_end:
Works like an Ender Bucket, but can hold 10 sources.

If sneaking, it will pick up as many sources as it can.
info.irregular_implements.returning_bloc: Works like a Block of Sticks, but teleports itself to the nearest player after breaking.
info.irregular_implements.sakanade_spore:
Found on the bottom of huge brown mushrooms.

Touching it inflicts you with Collapse for a short time, which inverts your controls.

This also inverts mobs' movement! They'll move the opposite direction they're trying to.
info.irregular_implements.shock_absorber: Reduces all fall damage, and also emits a redstone signal strength relative to the distance fallen.
info.irregular_implements.sided_redstone: Emits a Redstone signal on only one side.
info.irregular_implements.slime_cube:
Causes Slimes to spawn in great numbers in the chunk its in.

When powered, it instead prevents Slimes from spawning in the chunk.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_anchor: When crafted with an item, the item is kept after death.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_armor:
Comparable to Diamond Armor with higher durability and enchantability.

Also makes you slightly transparent!
info.irregular_implements.spectre_axe:
Comparable to a Diamond Axe with higher durability and enchantability.

Increases the block reach of the player by 3 blocks.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_block: An indestructible block that spawns in the Spectre Dimension.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_charge:
Charges items in your inventory with an infinite amount of energy.

Creative only!
Charge items in your inventory using energy from your Spectre Energy Buffer.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_coil_b:
Outputs FE from the Spectre Energy Buffer, which is filled using Spectre Energy Injectors.

Has a rate of 1,024 FE/t.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_coil_e:
Outputs FE from the Spectre Energy Buffer, which is filled using Spectre Energy Injectors.

Has a rate of 20,480 FE/t.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_coil_g: Generates an infinite amount of FE for free, inserting it into the block it's placed on.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_coil_n: Generates 128 FE/t for free, inserting it into the block it's placed on.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_coil_r:
Outputs FE from the Spectre Energy Buffer, which is filled using Spectre Energy Injectors.

Has a rate of 4,096 FE/t.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_energy:
Acts like an Ender Chest for FE.

FE can be inserted into the Spectre Energy Injector, but Spectre Coils are required to extract it.

A player's Spectre Energy Buffer can store up to 1,000,000 FE by default.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_illumi:
When used, spawns a Spectre Illuminator that lights up the entire chunk.

Can be removed either by clicking the Illuminator, or using Blackout Powder in the chunk.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_key:
Use for 5 seconds to teleport to a private dimension.

Do the same there to return.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_lens:
Place on a Beacon, and its effects will be granted to you no matter the distance.

Only works in the same dimension, and only when the Beacon's chunk is loaded.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_pickax:
Comparable to a Diamond Pickaxe with higher durability and enchantability.

Increases the block reach of the player by 3 blocks.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_saplin:
Created by using Ectoplasm on a Sapling.

Grows into a Spectre Tree, whose blocks have a chance of dropping Ectoplasm.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_shovel:
Comparable to a Diamond Shovel with higher durability and enchantability.

Increases the block reach of the player by 3 blocks.
info.irregular_implements.spectre_sword:
Comparable to a Diamond Sword with higher durability and enchantability.

Increases the entity reach range of the player by 3 blocks, and can be used to kill Spirits.
info.irregular_implements.stable_ender_p:
Use to bind to yourself.

Seven seconds after being dropped, it teleports the bound entity to it. If no entity is bound, it grabs a random entity within 10 blocks instead.
info.irregular_implements.summoning_pend: Found in dungeon chests, can be used to pick up and place entities.
info.irregular_implements.super_lubrican:
Can be applied to any Boots to make you slide when wearing them.

Can be washed with a Water Bottle after.
info.irregular_implements.trigger_glass:
When given a Redstone pulse, loses its collision for 3 seconds.

Also triggers adjacent Trigger Glass.
info.irregular_implements.void_stone: In its menu, has a slot that immediately deletes whatever is inserted.
info.irregular_implements.voiding_drop_f: Works like the Drop Filter, but deletes the items instead of preventing them from entering your inventory.
info.irregular_implements.water_walking_: Allows you to walk on water when not sneaking.
info.irregular_implements.white_stone:
Charges when held while under the full moon. When fully charged, it will prevent your death once and discharges.

Can be found in dungeon loot.
